title: Storyboard
lead: One keyframe per shot. Settle shot type, framing, blocking and transitions here, check the rhythm in the preview, then spend money on video.
spec: Aspect {{aspect}} · keyframes and video at {{w}}×{{h}} · change output spec

preview.label: Preview
preview.total: {{seconds}} s in total · current keyframes + dubbed lines + subtitles, free
preview.keys: Space plays / pauses; click the strip to jump

table.label: Shot table
table.mergeOf: Merge shot {{id}} with the next one

shot.label: Shot settings
shot.title: Shot {{id}}
shot.confirmed: {{id}} confirmed: first frame, references and settings are locked; ready for video.
shot.editTitle: Shot {{id}} is confirmed: the change reaches downstream
shot.tailOf: Continues from the last frame of {{id}}
shot.noKeyframe: No keyframe yet. Pick the Keyframes component on the right and click Rerun.
shot.tailText: No keyframe of its own: video generation starts from the last frame of {{id}}, so action and light carry over.
shot.tailDefault: For a new keyframe, change the shot type to “same scene, new angle”.

typeHint.continuous: Continues an earlier shot's action: its last frame is the first frame here, so people and light don't jump.
typeHint.same_scene_cut: Same scene, new angle or framing: a new keyframe using the locked references.
typeHint.scene_change: New location: new keyframe and scene reference, no forced continuity with the last shot.

shot.desc: Picture description (intent layer of the keyframe prompt)
shot.refs: References (only locked assets are sent to the model)
shot.noMoreRefs: All locked assets are already added

audioHint.native: The video model makes voice and lip-sync itself (H3 native audio), using the locked voice as reference.
audioHint.tts: Record the line with the locked voice first, then lip-sync the video to it; steadier for voice-over and long lines.
audioHint.none: No voice in this shot; only ambience and effects.

shot.blockingHint: Drag people and the camera (or select one and use the arrow keys); it feeds the keyframe prompt.
shot.noLines: No script line for this shot.

durationSource.audio: Set by the spoken audio (a breath each side), at least {{min}} s
durationSource.manualMin: Set by hand · not shorter than its audio, {{min}} s

shot.splitHint: Longer than {{max}} s (one video take): split the shot
shot.mergeNone: No later shot in this scene
shot.mergeDone: The next shot is merged into {{id}}
